newsitem.title: UK: IPE natural gas weaker but only three deals done.
newsitem.headline: IPE natural gas weaker but only three deals done.

text.p: The IPE natural gas futures market saw minimal trade on Tuesday, with only three deals done over the whole day accounting for a total of 20 lots.
The last of these trades, a five-lot deal in October at 12.50 pence a therm, was done only seconds before the close of the exchange's two-hour afternoon session.
All three deals saw prices fall, by between 0.075 pence and 0.10 pence a therm. The traded months were October, March 1998 with 10 lots, and May 1998 with five lots.

The slow trade mirrored activity on the physical market on Tuesday morning, described by dealers as quiet. The first trading day of the week is frequently quiet on the IPE, with only 60 lots traded a week ago Monday and 20 lots on Monday April 21.
